onnx.output: mean action (pre-clip); the runtime clips to [-1, 1]

arena.note: 2.4384 m (8 ft) square, origin at the centre, +x right, +y up, yaw CCW from +x

actuation.throttle: throttle command in [-1, 1], + forward. The firmware multiplies it by its `limit` (duty = |throttle| x limit); the model was trained with a command of 1.0 reaching 2.68 m/s, so set `limit` on each car until full command reads that speed (sim duty 0.37). Zero throttle COASTS; the model brakes by commanding reverse.
actuation.steer: proportional steering target, fraction of max_steer_rad, + left
actuation.trained_with: proportional servo steering, 50% of episodes with a one-step (0.1 s) command delay; observations through the two-corner-camera emulator

car.model: MotorDayz 1:16 MD Elite (R8-16CTRKIT1), Corvette body, grip tyres, 4WD

notes: Pose inputs only: (x, y, heading) per car from the cameras; signed speed from consecutive poses (the loop's SignedSpeed); yaw rate, steering target and last command are tracked inside the runtime.
